added.member: UI document popover placement (position-area, insets, position-try-fallbacks on a popover)
added.summary: An open popover is placed by CSS anchor positioning against its implicit anchor, the control whose popovertarget or interestfor opened it: position-area picks the side and alignment, an inset (left: 8px beside a right-hand popover) offsets it, and position-try-fallbacks and @position-try flip it inside the safe area. A popover with none of them still hangs under its control, above it where there is more room.

A popover's ::-og-arrow { width; background } draws a square turned 45° across the edge facing its anchor, over the anchor's middle where the box allows, and hides while no side faces it. Its colour defaults to the popover's background.
contextmenu="id" on an element opens popover id at the point of a secondary press or long press on it; that zero-size point is its anchor, so position-area and fallbacks place it there.

packages/engine/src/ui/components/menu.svelte (commands, checks, radios, separators, headers, shortcuts and a drill-in submenu) and tooltip-card.svelte (rarity title and pips, art slot, stat rows with deltas, a comparison card, footer and action hints). Put them in a popover, or eject them with og ui eject menu and og ui eject tooltip-card.

breaking.change: The menu and context menu builders are removed.
breaking.fix: Write `<menu id="Menu" popover>` with buttons opened by `popovertarget="Menu"`. For a context menu, put `contextmenu="Menu"` on the element that is right-clicked or long-pressed. For entries from a store, eject the `menu` component document and read the choice from og.ui.docEvents.
